params.command:
$ErrorActionPreference='Stop'
$dest = Join-Path $env:TEMP 'mhw-agentcontrol-shipit-a1'
if (Test-Path $dest) { Remove-Item -Recurse -Force $dest }
git clone https://github.com/fengie/mhw-mods.git $dest
git -C $dest fetch origin main feature/agent-control-plane-v2-20260928
git -C $dest checkout -B feature/agent-control-plane-v2-20260928 origin/feature/agent-control-plane-v2-20260928
git -C $dest merge --no-edit origin/main
Write-Output '===HEAD==='
git -C $dest rev-parse HEAD
Write-Output '===MAIN==='
git -C $dest rev-parse origin/main
Write-Output '===STATUS==='
git -C $dest status --short
Write-Output '===SERVER MATCHES==='
Select-String -Path (Join-Path $dest 'tools\agent-control\server.mjs') -Pattern 'assertWorkerPlacement|approve-for-me|deployOne|findCodex|repositoryWriteAuthorized' -Context 10,24 | Out-String -Width 240
Write-Output '===CORE MACHINE POLICY==='
Select-String -Path (Join-Path $dest 'tools\agent-control\lib\control-core.mjs') -Pattern 'DEFAULT_MACHINE_POLICIES|canUseMachineForRepositoryWrite|heaven2|heaven' -Context 8,28 | Out-String -Width 240
